canonical.heading: IDE: Agent Plugin Support and Session Pinning
canonical.summary: This version supports Powers packaged in the open Agent Plugin format and reworks the Agent Focus Mode session rail with pinning, Kiro CLI hand-off, and in-app updates. It also moves Kiro to Code OSS v1.109.5, improves how spec hovers and MCP installs handle untrusted workspace content, and adds bulk session migration and steadier error recovery.

canonical.heading: CLI: Tangent Side-Conversations and Per-Tool Token Breakdown
canonical.summary: This release introduces tangents: branch into side-conversations that inherit your full conversation history, explore freely, then jump back exactly where you left off. /context also gains a per-tool token breakdown so you can see what's consuming your context window.

canonical.heading: IDE: Editor Actions, Guided Hook Creation, and Code OSS Upgrade
canonical.summary: This version adds a Kiro submenu to the editor context menu and an Ask Kiro to Fix quick fix on errors and warnings, plus a guided form for creating hooks. Kiro moves to Code OSS v1.108.2, and now replies in your IDE display language. Chat history also survives workspace folder changes, and several sign-in, trust, and approval issues are fixed.

canonical.heading: CLI: Spec Drafting and Plan Auto-Execution
canonical.summary: This version adds a guided description step to /spec new and makes Plan mode execute your approved plan automatically without a manual mode switch.

canonical.heading: Models: Claude Opus 5 Now Available
canonical.summary: Claude Opus 5 is now available in the Kiro IDE, CLI, and Web. It's a meaningful step up from Opus 4.8 on the hardest agentic coding tasks — setting new state-of-the-art results on leading coding benchmarks, more than doubling Opus 4.8's performance while approaching Fable 5 at half the cost. Excels at multi-file features, large refactors, and end-to-end feature work, completing full tasks rather t

canonical.heading: CLI: V2 to V3 Agent Migration
canonical.summary: This release introduces /upgrade-agent to migrate V2 custom agent configurations to the universal format, automatic retries for interrupted model responses, and quality-of-life improvements across both modes.

canonical.heading: IDE: Global Hooks, Session Search, and Reliability Fixes
canonical.summary: This release adds user-level global hooks, a searchable session history panel, and stronger reliability for corporate proxy environments. The agent now recovers automatically from interrupted responses and refreshes MCP tools dynamically.

canonical.heading: CLI: Introspect Subagent and Global Hooks
canonical.summary: This release brings two new capabilities to CLI 3.0 (early access) a built-in subagent for learning Kiro's features and global hooks that apply across all workspaces alongside error handling fixes for all users.

canonical.heading: Models: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna now available
canonical.summary: OpenAI models are available in Kiro for the first time. GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna bring three tiers of frontier intelligence to the IDE, CLI, and Web — each tuned for a different point on the performance-cost curve. Sol is the flagship, built for the hardest multi-step work: spec-driven implementation, long-horizon refactors, and complex terminal tasks. It scores 80 on the Coding Agent Index an

canonical.heading: IDE: Faster Sessions, Compaction Fixes, and PowerShell Trust
canonical.summary: Note: To get the latest 1.0.x release, download it directly from kiro.dev/downloads. Auto-updates are being rolled out gradually to users.

canonical.heading: IDE: Hooks on Agent Writes, Lazy MCP Auth, and Multi-Window Sync
canonical.summary: Note: To get the latest 1.0.x release, download it directly from kiro.dev/downloads. Auto-updates are being rolled out gradually to users.

canonical.heading: CLI: Expanded MCP OAuth Support
canonical.summary: MCP OAuth now supports servers with strict requirements, like Figma. Configure a client secret for servers that require one, point the redirect URI at a custom callback path, and skip Dynamic Client Registration when you bring your own client ID. This release also brings more accurate approval prompts for commands with combined flags, and full ASCII mode coverage for terminals without Unicode supp

canonical.heading: IDE: Session Restore, Performance Optimizations, and Custom Agent Enhancements
canonical.summary: Note: To get the latest 1.0.x release (1.0.89 or later), download it directly from kiro.dev/downloads. Auto-updates are paused at this time and we are working on re-enabling them.

canonical.heading: General: Custom Overage Caps via Service Quotas
canonical.summary: Enterprise administrators can now set custom caps for overages using AWS Service Quotas. The quota field Maximum allowed overage per Kiro profile controls the maximum allowed overage for every user in the profile, preventing unexpected costs while keeping users productive. Admins can manage overage caps directly in the Service Quotas console, or navigate there from the Manage link in the Overages
